description.la: Meditatio de mysteriis Christi in duodecim fructibus arboris vitae, per mysterium originis, passionis et glorificationis. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Decem opuscula, 1900), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A meditation on the life of Christ as a tree of twelve fruits, in the mysteries of his origin, his passion and his glorification; each fruit has four verses on Jesus and a prayer. The Latin is the Quaracchi text of the Decem opuscula (1900), from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Meditação sobre a vida de Cristo como uma árvore de doze frutos, nos mistérios de sua origem, de sua paixão e de sua glorificação.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Decem opuscula ad theologiam mysticam spectantia, ed. 2 (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1900).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR of the octavo edition. Page heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings and cross-references) and note markers are removed; line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by comparison with the other Quaracchi scans, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1900 is public domain.
